title: An extension crosses typed WIT values, runs on its request's core under that request's budget, and holds only what its entry, its manifest and its caller all grant
scope: Everything 0003 left open about Tier 1: the WIT type of a value, the `nvs:ext@1.0.0` world's imports, the manifest and source sections, the required pin, how a call runs on a core and under which limits, what a failure throws, which I/O a guest may be granted and by whom, and `nvs ext`. The built-in components are 0247; the intl API and the WIT text are later work.
dependsOnText: [0003](0003.md) (the three tiers and the sandbox), [0055](0055.md) (the qualifier axis at the boundary), [0078](0078.md) (reload and `env_hash`), [0120](0120.md) (the image component's entry points), [0051](0051.md) (tier placement).
validatedBy: The acceptance checks of the M9 goals `ext-host`, `ext-compiler`, `ext-grants` and `ext-tooling`, and `benches/abi-probe`'s `wasm-probe` guards.
